segments.name: Cloud-based Technology (CBT)
segments.description: Sells cloud-based products, data storage servers and advertising services to private-sector customers in China.
segments.evidence: It includes the Company's cloud-based products, high-end data storage servers and related services sold to private sectors including new media, healthcare, education and residential community management, and among other industries and applications.

segments.name: Traditional Information Technology (TIT)
segments.description: Project-based technology products and services sold to public-sector customers, being gradually phased out.
segments.evidence: The TIT segment includes the Company's project-based technology products and services sold to the public sector.

segments.name: Smart Elevator (SE)
segments.description: Elevator sales, installation, repair, maintenance and upgrades for governments, businesses and households.
segments.evidence: As a provider of elevator services, the Company provides services throughout the entire elevator lifecycle, including sales, installation, repair, cloud-based maintenance, renovation, and upgrades.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for advertising, hardware, software maintenance, technology services, and elevator sales, installation and maintenance.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenues from advertising, selling hardware, software maintenance, other technology-related services, and elevator projects and services to customers.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company added the Smart Elevator (SE) segment after acquiring Skyladder Group.
changes.evidence: Following the acquisition of Skyladder Group in November 2025, the Company added the Smart Elevator (SE) segment.
